Planner here. parse.py (auth) and transform.py (backend) are both landed and the shapes line up: parse emits {ident, person, worth, gauge, moment, variety}; transform consumes that and returns {ident, person, worth:float, moment:int, variety, group}. Your report.run(list_of_raw_lines) should drive parse_line then normalize then summarize. The record normalize returns to you has: worth already cleaned (hundredths->/100, thousandth->*1000, plain pass; rounded 2dp), group is a named class string (class code 1/4->retail, 2->food, 7->travel, else other), and normalize drops (returns None) anyone whose person starts with "test-" or whose moment < 1700000000. Build the summary on that record shape, push report.py, and I'll run acceptance.py against the composition.
